description: Given a vector of integers and a target integer, return the two zero-based positions whose values add to the target. The input has exactly one valid pair, and the same element cannot be used twice. The two positions may be returned in either order.
constraints: The vector contains at least two integers and at most 10,000 integers.
Each value and the target are between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.
Exactly one pair satisfies the target.
An element may not be used twice.
